title: Pool Service Form
subtitle: Residential Pool Service: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Pool Service Form covers pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature. The residential pool-service coordinator records Residential Pool Service activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Pool Service Form keeps Residential Pool Service exceptions visible until the residential pool-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Service Form at residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate. Document pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature identity before Residential Pool Service begins. Compare pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature findings with stated Residential Pool Service criteria; route unresolved Residential Pool Service issues to qualified pool-service reviewer. For Pool Service Form, confirm requirements for Residential Pool Service. Ask qualified pool-service reviewer to review Residential Pool Service conditions beyond the residential pool-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Activity parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Pool Service, identify responsible parties, residential pool, spa, equipment pad, chemical storage, and access gate, and the linked pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature source.

fields.label: Service interval, target range, and prior reading

sections.title: Recorded quantities, results, and controls
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Pool Service facts for pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Pool Service operating checks
items: Filter pressure, flow, pump, and leak condition
Skimmer, basket, surface, wall, floor, and debris condition
Chemical supply, feeder, storage, and label condition
Gate, barrier, drain cover, and visible deck condition
Adjustment, circulation, retest, and customer restriction

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating action
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Pool Service conditions; have residential pool-service coordinator assign the next Residential Pool Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Equipment cannot circulate or maintain control
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pool Service when water, chemical, circulation, barrier, visibility, or safe-use control remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Pool Service proof and route unresolved pool or spa, circulation, filtration, chemical feed, controller, and deck feature scope to residential pool-service coordinator.
